input.description: What greeter accepts — the CloudEvent `data` (ADR-0058 I/O contract). The push build generates a closed JSON Schema from this type and bakes an eval-free validator the shim runs BEFORE the handler: a wrong-shaped input (missing/!string `name`) is rejected with **422** and never reaches `handle`. `name` is required.

output.description: What greeter returns — the 200 JSON body (also validated; a bad return is a 500).
